status: frozen before main experimental inference; synthetic access checks and prior diagnostic pilots already existed
model_identity_caveat: requested serving aliases; immutable backend snapshot not independently attested

conditions.S: Common compact taxonomy only, one call
conditions.C: S plus the complete extracted Topintzi et al. 2019 document, one call
conditions.E: S plus 15 seeded demonstrations from separate60 pool (5 per position), one call
conditions.R: Shared S output plus self-revision instruction, one further call
conditions.V: Shared S output plus frozen original verifier feedback, one further call
conditions.W: Shared S output plus isolated repaired verifier feedback, one further call

unit: pair; ten pairs per fresh independent session; same ordering and batches in all conditions
legacy_design: S only, all three models and two replicates; separate from main300 and literal historical-prompt26 diagnostic
replication: independent sessions; service defaults for temperature, no exposed inference seed; repeat pairing shares input batches
primary_metric: joint exact agreement of stress position and unordered canonical feature set with stored automatic reference
secondary_metrics: core joint agreement excluding COPY and MOSAIC in both prediction and reference
denominators: All planned predictions retained; absent, malformed or tool-using outputs are joint/type/exact errors. Feature micro misses count all reference features as FN.
empty_features: Per-item F1=1 for two empty sets,0 for empty/nonempty; invalid output F1=0 even if reference empty.

statistics.primary_uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap over fixed10-pair inference batches; average two replicates within item; resample30batches
statistics.sensitivity: resample observed author/source groups, with all pairs of a group kept together; report few-group limitation
statistics.multiplicity: descriptive paired95percentile intervals; no unadjusted significance declarations
statistics.replicate_stability: per model/condition exact label-set consistency across two repeats

retry_policy: At most2 transport attempts; never retry completed malformed answers, tool-use, or low-scoring answers.
revision_failure_policy: No valid S inference means dependent R/V/W prediction errors for whole batch; do not replace S.
scope: positive automatic-reference pool, not rhyme detection
balancedstress sample is not corpus prevalence
verifier feedback is related to the label-producing system, so agreement gains are not independent accuracy gains
source corpus systematically omits some COPY/MOSAIC features emitted by live verifier; full-set primary is literal stored-label agreement; core joint metric is a prespecified sensitivity analysis
no poem identifiers, only pair duplicate filtering
full context condition is text extraction with documented source recovery
three models from one provider family; not cross-provider evidence
no dollar cost inferred from Codex subscription usage
